paper_title: CAPSTONE Curriculum Sampling for Dense Retrieval with Document   Expansion
caption: Comparison of different query selection strategies. During training, we first expand the document with a query selected from the generated queries using a specific strategy, and then train DPR with the expanded document. During inference, we evaluate the well-trained DPR retrievers with corpus expansion (solid lines) and the typical representation (dotted lines) on the dev set of MS-Marco, where the solid and dotted lines with the same color are results for the same DPR.
model_annotation: The plot compares different query selection strategies for document expansion in dense retrieval, showing the MRR@10 metric on the y-axis (ranging from 33.0 to 36.5) against the number of queries used during inference (S), on the x-axis, which ranges from 1 to 10 on a linear scale. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and has tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and has tick marks at intervals of 0.5. Five strategies are represented by distinct colored lines: black (DPR w/o query), yellow (DPR w/ gold), green (DPR w/ top-1), purple (DPR w/ bottom-1), and blue (DPR w/ random). The red line corresponds to DPR w/ curriculum. Solid lines indicate performance with corpus expansion during inference, while dotted lines represent performance with the typical representation (no expansion). The green line (DPR w/ top-1) starts at approximately 33.0 MRR@10 when S=1 and increases steadily to about 36.4 at S=10. The red line (DPR w/ curriculum) starts at around 35.2, rises slightly to about 35.7 at S=4, then plateaus. The blue line (DPR w/ random) begins at about 34.8 and remains relatively flat, ending near 35.2. The purple line (DPR w/ bottom-1) starts at 35.0 and gradually declines to approximately 34.6. The yellow line (DPR w/ gold) starts at 33.0 and rises slowly to about 35.0 at S=10. The black line (DPR w/o query) is not visible in the plot, likely because it is constant and below the visible range. Dotted lines for each strategy are horizontally aligned with their corresponding solid lines, indicating no improvement from expansion for those methods.
